facts.fact: The consortium implementing Enabel's REVIS project says it digitised the census and collection of market taxes and motorcycle-taxi parking taxes in Mamou, with taxi collection running since June 2026.
The post names one local authority, Mamou, where the REVIS digitised census and collection of local taxes was carried out.
The implementing consortium says Mamou's market revenues were multiplied by four, and weekly motorcycle-taxi parking collections since June 2026 equal a full year's collection before the project.
The REVIS project in Mamou was commissioned and funded by Enabel and awarded to a Global Itec and Le Partenariat consortium in November 2025.
